name: opentripmap_places_radius
description: Find points of interest (tourist attractions, museums, restaurants, historic sites, etc.) within a radius of a lat/lon point. Returns matching POIs with xid, name, kind categories, distance from the center, and coordinates. Example: opentripmap_places_radius({ lat: 48.8566, lon: 2.3522, radius: 1000, kinds: "museums", limit: 20, _apiKey: "your-key" })

lat.description: Latitude of the search center, e.g. 48.8566

lon.description: Longitude of the search center, e.g. 2.3522

kinds.description: Optional comma-separated category filter, e.g. "museums", "historic,architecture", "foods". See OpenTripMap "kinds" taxonomy.

limit.description: Max number of POIs to return (default 50)

rate.description: Optional minimum importance rating: "1","2","3","1h","2h","3h" (h = has Wikidata/heritage). Filters to more notable places.

name: opentripmap_place_detail
description: Get full details for a single place by its OpenTripMap xid (obtained from opentripmap_places_radius or opentripmap_autosuggest). Returns name, address, categories, Wikidata/Wikipedia links, description extract, image, and website. Example: opentripmap_place_detail({ xid: "N123456", _apiKey: "your-key" })

name: opentripmap_geoname
description: Resolve a city / place name to geographic coordinates and metadata (lat, lon, population, country, timezone). Use this to turn a place name into a lat/lon you can feed to opentripmap_places_radius. Example: opentripmap_geoname({ name: "Paris", country: "FR", _apiKey: "your-key" })

country.description: Optional ISO 3166 two-letter country code to disambiguate, e.g. "FR", "US"

name: opentripmap_autosuggest
description: Typeahead / partial-name search for POIs near a lat/lon point. Matches place names by prefix within a radius — good for "find places starting with X near here". Returns matching POIs with xid, name, kinds, distance, and coordinates. Example: opentripmap_autosuggest({ name: "louv", lat: 48.8566, lon: 2.3522, radius: 5000, _apiKey: "your-key" })

name.description: Partial place name to match, e.g. "louv"
